title: 2020 Pan-STARRS object turns out to be a 1966 NASA booster

tellings.quote: In September of 2020, Pan-STARRS found another object that was similarly baffling.

plain: In September 2020, Pan-STARRS, a telescope in Hawaii that surveys the sky for moving objects, found something in space that seemed "similarly baffling" to an earlier strange visitor, and it was later identified as a NASA rocket booster from 1966. Michels tells this himself in an episode with the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb, as an example of how a puzzling object in space can turn out to be human-made junk.
